description: Migrate stateless workloads from on-demand EC2 to Spot instances with interruption handling. Must: identify spot-eligible workloads (stateless, fault-tolerant), design instance diversification strategy (multiple instance types, AZs), configure Spot Fleet with capacity rebalancing, set up interruption handling (drain + reschedule within 2 minutes), launch spot fleet, drain traffic from on-demand to spot, verify service stability, and maintain on-demand fallback pool. Risk factors: spot interruption causing service degradation, insufficient capacity in preferred AZs, drain mechanism too slow. Tools available: aws CLI, Spot Fleet, terraform, kubectl, Prometheus.
